latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Web3 Grant Tracker.

- Track active Web3 grant rounds, deadlines, and opportunities across major platforms (Gitcoin, Giveth, Octant, Optimism RPGF, Arbitrum, and more)
- Stay informed with WhatsApp/Telegram alerts 48h and 24h before round deadlines
- Calculate estimated Quadratic Funding (QF) match based on donor count per project and round
- Check your project's eligibility for active rounds and track your application status
- View all active, upcoming, and past rounds in a unified portfolio dashboard with historical funding data
- All data stored locally; no telemetry; grant data refreshed every 6 hours via public APIs
